_about: Reviewable curation for public/data/context/<id>.json, built by scripts/build-context.mjs. Backbone: sunnah.com 'Special Virtues of the Qur'an's Chapters and Verses' (sunnah.com/virtues), plus the owner's seed list. Hadith wording and grades are never typed here: the build script copies them from the saved sunnah.com pages (scripts/raw/context/sunnah-hadith-pages.json). This file only says WHICH narration goes under WHICH surah, and why anything was left out. Rule: include only narrations in Sahih al-Bukhari or Sahih Muslim, or graded Sahih/Hasan in sunnah.com's grade field by a named grader, with no conflicting weak grade. Everything stays 'unverified' until the owner's reviewer signs off.
_hadeethenc: Cross-check: sunnah.com narration -> HadeethEnc (Hadith Encyclopedia) record of the same hadith, matched by Arabic wording and confirmed by reading both. HadeethEnc covers only some hadith; narrations without a match are graded by sunnah.com's named grader alone.
